required_outcomes: Finds the landlord's own email of 14/09/2023 on the record (event 016) consenting to a pet flap in the utility room back door at the tenants' cost, on condition it is done properly and the door is reinstated at the end of the tenancy if he asks.
Replies to the landlord politely quoting that consent and its conditions, and asks whether he has any concern about how it was fitted, rather than treating the flap as unapproved.
Handles the key separately: asks the tenant whether and when the front door lock was changed and for a spare key for the management file, and tells the landlord what will happen about his own copy.
acceptable_alternatives: Sending the landlord a copy or quotation of the 14/09/2023 email and leaving any further flap step to his reply.
Noting the reinstatement condition for the end-of-tenancy check-out at the same time.
positive_behaviours: Notes that the summary email of event 017 said 'no issues' although the report mentions the flap, and that the record explains why.
Keeps the tenant out of the consent question, since the landlord's consent is on file.
red_flags: Telling the tenant the flap was not approved or asking her to justify it when the landlord's consent is on file.
Escalating to a human over a question the record answers.
prohibited_actions: Instructing a contractor to remove the flap or change the locks.
critical_failures: Telling the landlord the flap was fitted without consent, or asking the tenant to remove it, when the record holds his written consent.
